main.description: Fetch — and thereby silently renew — the authenticated supporter's entitlement credentials ('membership cards') from this issuer. AUTH: OAuth session as the supporter, carrying the payments scope. Returned tokens are freshly minted with validity capped at min(7 days, end of paid period); clients should call this whenever a held credential is within 24 hours of expiry. An entitlement that has lapsed (cancelled, charged back, or unpaid) simply stops appearing — non-renewal is the revocation mechanism.

creator.description: Optional filter: only credentials for entitlements with this creator.

token.description: The compact JWS entitlement credential (typ 'ent+jwt'). Opaque to clients; presented to apps and verified per the spec's verification algorithm.

creator.description: Convenience copy of ctx.creator for client bookkeeping.

expiresAt.description: Convenience copy of the token's exp.
